flags.statement: A hailstorm of contempt and ridicule throws so much sidelight upon that rationalistic temper…
flags.reason: "that rationalistic temper", "the temper of pragmatism": the note never introduces these tempers or says what the opposition between them is. "That" and "the" treat them as already established.

flags.statement: Pragmatism only follows here the example of the sister-sciences…
flags.reason: "here", "the sister-sciences": no earlier statement says which sciences are meant or what "here" points to.

flags.statement: It brings old and new harmoniously together.
flags.reason: "old and new": it is not stated what is old and what is new.
